My services

From a small fine line flower to a full realism sleeve. We always start with a conversation about your idea.

  • Tattoos

    From the first sketch to the finished piece. We choose the motif, size and placement together, without rushing.

  • Fine line

    Thin, precise lines and soft shading. For florals, small motifs and delicate details.

  • Realism

    Black and grey realism with depth and contrast. Animals, mythology, angels and dark themes.

  • Memorial tattoos

    A memory you carry with you. Hands, silhouettes and symbols for the people you love.

  • Cover-ups

    An old tattoo you no longer like can become something completely new. Send a photo and we’ll look at the options.

  • Custom designs

    No copies. I draw a unique design from your idea, your references and the shape of your body.

Who is behind Sky Ink?

Hi, I’m Skaiste

I opened Sky Ink in Askim in 2019. Since then I’ve tattooed everything from tiny fine line flowers to full black and grey realism sleeves.

Realism, fine line and memorial tattoos are closest to my heart – pieces that mean something to the person wearing them. Many people also come to me with an old tattoo they want to bring back to life, and cover-ups are some of my favourite projects.

To me, every tattoo, whether it’s new or a cover-up, is a small artwork. I put my whole heart into each one, and I take my time so you feel comfortable all the way.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a tattoo cost?

The price depends on size, level of detail and placement. Send an inquiry with a picture of your idea and the spot on your body, and you’ll get an estimate before we book.

Do I need to pay a deposit?

Yes. Your appointment is confirmed once the deposit is paid, and the amount is deducted from the price of the tattoo.

Does it hurt?

You’ll feel it, but most people find it easier than they expected. Some areas, like ribs, feet and the inner arm, are more sensitive. Sleep well, eat before your appointment and drink water for the best experience. We take breaks whenever you need.

Can you cover up an old tattoo?

Yes, cover-ups are one of my specialties. Send a photo of the tattoo you want covered. Dark, dense tattoos often need a larger and darker design, and sometimes a few laser sessions first pay off. We’ll figure it out together.

How old do I have to be?

You must be 18 or older, even with parental consent. Please bring valid ID to your appointment.

How do I look after my new tattoo?

You’ll get aftercare advice to take home. There’s also a guide further down this page. Go to the aftercare guide

Can I bring my own drawing?

Absolutely. Upload your references in the form and I’ll draw a design that fits your body and ages well.

Tattoo aftercare

A tattoo heals in 2–4 weeks. Good care in the first weeks keeps the lines crisp and the shading soft for years.

  1. 01

    Keep the wrap on

    Leave the bandage or protective film on for as long as I recommended. Wash your hands before removing it.

  2. 02

    Wash gently

    Wash with lukewarm water and a mild, fragrance-free soap. Pat dry with clean paper – don’t rub.

  3. 03

    A thin layer of cream

    Apply a thin layer of tattoo balm or fragrance-free moisturiser 2–3 times a day. Your skin needs to breathe.

  4. 04

    Don’t scratch or pick

    It will itch and flake a little as it heals. That’s completely normal. Let the flakes fall off on their own.

  5. 05

    Avoid water and sun

    Stay away from baths, pools, sea swimming, saunas, tanning beds and direct sun until the skin has healed.

  6. 06

    Sunscreen for life

    Once healed, use high-factor sunscreen (SPF 50). That keeps your tattoo sharp for a long time.

If the area becomes more red, warm or swollen after a few days, or you get a fever, contact a doctor.
